paragraphs.text:
Sylvia points out that the brush around the sasquatch camp is 
very dry. You form a plan. She will take the matches from your 
coat pocket, cross the camp and duck into the thickets, where 
she will start a diversionary blaze. It ought to be a good trick 
since it seems the sasquatches have no knowledge of fire.

Make a Luck roll for Sylvia: if it succeeds, go to 401; if it fails, 
go to 388.
